This game is fire. Been on it since like. 2014 on xbox. CROSS PLATFORM ACCOUNT MERGE is what has allowed me to get back into it. I would also recommend the game to new players. Start with a group of friends. This game is not that friendly to new players. Having a group to play with thats around the same mastery level will increase your likelihood of getting into it. The current experience is incredibly different from the OG experience players such as me have grown to know. You guys remember Void keys(T3 survival, T4 defense, the best ones)? Wallrunning? Coptering? Bad objective scaling(objectives having like 2000 health on wave 30 or high levels)? The nostalgia. Seeing the games development and mechanics change and to anticipate big updates whilst maxing out levels on all of the currently available weapons/warframes was definitely a unique experience that will never be available again. The introduction of all of the different mechanics and story and gameplay changes in bite size amounts made being there at the time the golden age of warframe. Being able to slowly get used to each big update made a big difference. I know it would be overwhelming to start from the beginning from the current game state, but a group of friends and you will be able to enjoy experiencing all sorts of gameplay and progression and learning about all of the weapons/warframes/companions/et cetera and having a group would make it more enjoyable. Farming with that group will help everyone progress together, learn together, watch and share build or informative videos together and all sorts of stuff. Give it a try. warframe is completely free. Paying money will just allow you to get cosmetics, built weapons/warframes and remove time blocks and basically just save time. I would recommend dropping money on the accessory pack for affinity and credit boosting and then using the platinum to buy a resource booster for 30 days. Avoid it unless your friends are going to do it as well as you will double credits and resources received. If they dont do it, you will leave them in the dust and that will make it less fun for them. while you have all of the necessary resources and credits for creating that new frame they need several more missions. so think strategically. And thats all from me. 

Have a nice day.
